svg.title: Split-K reduction — one output token across launches or CTAs — global_projection_c1024_fp16
svg.desc: Source-ordered split reduction for one selected scalar. Each split covers a disjoint K interval; Half scratch carries the running result. Only the final split performs the final consumer-specific publication.
svg.text: Split-K reduction — one output token across launches or CTAs
Follow output token 3, channel 2: K1024 = 4 ordered contributions of K256.
Working-format inputs do not imply working-format scratch: intermediate split sums remain Half.
Final split: publish the complete result after the single residual contribution and all K ranges are included.
Native mode uses the source completion-counter protocol; OrderedSplit mode uses launch order. These boxes are dependencies, not GPU issue cycles.
